# ReconfigurableNonlinearPhotonicNetwork

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A photonic circuit with tunable nonlinear elements that can be dynamically reprogrammed to implement different computational functions. Provides the flexibility needed to support multiple learning tasks and memory states within a single physical substrate.
